title: Linearity of finite probability expectation
statement: For a finite set $\Omega$, a probability mass function $\pi$ on $\Omega$, real scalars $a,b,c,d$, and functions $f,g,h,k:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$, the expectation of their linear combination is $\mathbb{E}_{\pi}[af+bg+ch+dk]=a\mathbb{E}_{\pi}[f]+b\mathbb{E}_{\pi}[g]+c\mathbb{E}_{\pi}[h]+d\mathbb{E}_{\pi}[k]$.
